validation_notes: First-pass CPU-trained model on Mendeley rice data. Validation accuracy 0.9055, macro F1 0.9036. Not Indonesian field-certified.
limitations: The selected source does not include healthy rice images, so this ONNX model predicts the four disease classes only
Dataset may not represent all field conditions
Symptoms may overlap with nutrient stress or pest damage
Low-confidence results must be reviewed by an expert
